scope: Exactly 8 fixed U.S. Treasury/Fed-Treasury episodes; no outcome labels, probabilities, or production changes.
source_family_rules: home.treasury.gov and treasurydirect.gov are one US_TREASURY issuer lineage.
Fed Board releases and Fed Chair signed reply share FEDERAL_RESERVE_BOARD lineage.
HTML/PDF versions of one letter are the same underlying document.
Joint facility releases support one joint episode; do not count duplicated capacity facts as independent observations.
Current buyback index is archaeology-only and cannot become historical decision-time evidence.
cut_rules: Date-only publication becomes America/New_York day interval; cut is conservative following local midnight.
Observed Fed Apr9 08:30EDT retained as exact first-public clock; next-day cut admits Treasury date-only co-release.
Scheduled refunding 08:30 notices are retained as schedule only; timezone convention is explicitly inferred, not stated exact release clock.
Nov19 primary cut excludes Nov20 formal Fed reply; optional sensitivity cut never adds an independent episode.
May29 result native filename encodes operation start, not publication time; next-day cut with allocation executed but settlement scheduled.
certification_limitations: Historical original bearing contemporary date/time; current-host retrieval does not prove byte identity or absence of unmarked edits.
Date-only certification supports overnight point-in-time analysis, not intraday release-window claims.
Prices, futures/OIS probabilities, DXY and causal event returns not reconstructed. Root must abstain or supply controlled data rather than manufacture certainty.
Private motive is unresolved; selective incidence alone is not motive proof.
